name: SONIC
description: SONIC is the native Token-2022 asset of SONIC Network, designed for creator rewards, ecosystem participation, tokenized content, platform utility, and on-chain creator commerce.

attributes.value: Creator rewards, governance, staking, access, commerce, fees, licensing, and ecosystem participation

creator_rewards.description: Reward eligible creators, contributors, collaborators, and community participants from funded SONIC reward allocations.

staking.description: Stake SONIC for protocol participation, ecosystem incentives, and configurable lock-based reward programs.

governance.description: Participate in eligible SONIC governance proposals, voting, delegation, and policy decisions.

platform_access.description: Unlock token-gated platform features, creator tools, experiences, releases, communities, and premium ecosystem access.

creator_commerce.description: Use SONIC in creator marketplace purchases, direct-to-fan commerce, tipping, subscriptions, collectibles, and digital goods.

licensing.description: Support on-chain creator licensing, usage rights, permissions, and royalty-linked workflows where enabled.

tokenized_content.description: Participate in SONIC tokenized music, media, creator assets, memberships, editions, and collectible experiences.

fees.description: SONIC uses Token-2022 transfer-fee mechanics and may be used for protocol or product fee settlement where explicitly quoted.

rewards_and_loyalty.description: Power fan rewards, loyalty programs, campaigns, quests, referrals, and ecosystem incentive programs.

community.description: Coordinate memberships, community participation, access tiers, campaigns, and ecosystem contribution programs.

payments.description: Use SONIC as an optional settlement asset across supported SONIC applications alongside SOL, USDC, and EURC.

ecosystem_participation.description: Coordinate incentives across SONIC Studio, applications, marketplace, creator services, APIs, and on-chain integrations.
